gates.description: All resources must be tagged with team, service, environment, cost-center
Cost estimate must be provided before deployment of new services
Unit cost metrics must be defined (cost per request, cost per user, cost per transaction)
Autoscaling must be configured with appropriate min/max limits
Automated cost anomaly alerts must be configured (>20% above baseline)
Development and staging environments must be right-sized and scheduled to shut down

anti_patterns.description: Randomly downgrading instances without 30 days of utilization data — measure before cutting
Cutting costs so aggressively that reliability suffers — removing redundancy to save money
Development environments running the same instance sizes as production — $10,000/month on idle dev
Committing to 3-year reserved instances for workloads that might change
Designing the architecture, building the service, then asking how much it costs after deployment

escalation_triggers: Cloud spend exceeds budget by >25% with no clear explanation
A single team's costs are growing >50% month-over-month
Optimization requires architectural changes that affect multiple teams
Reserved capacity commitment decision exceeds team authority (large dollar amounts)
Cost anomaly detected that might indicate a security incident (crypto mining, data exfiltration)
Vendor pricing change significantly impacts projected costs

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with infrastructure requirements and budget constraints

output_certifications: All resources tagged (team, service, environment, cost-center)
Cost estimate provided for new services before deployment
Unit cost metrics defined (cost per request/user/transaction)
Automated cost anomaly alerts configured (>20% above baseline)
Development environments right-sized and scheduled for shutdown
